sub_questions.text: (क) डैन, एल्फ तथा फरहान एक फर्म में साझेदार थे तथा 5:3:2 के अनुपात में लाभों का विभाजन करते थे । 1 अप्रैल, 2023 से उन्होंने अपने लाभ-विभाजन अनुपात को 2:3:5 में परिवर्तित करने का निर्णय लिया । लाभ-विभाजन अनुपात में परिवर्तन की तिथि पर ₹ 90,000 का सामान्य संचय था। साझेदारों ने निर्णय लिया कि सामान्य संचय को बाँटा नहीं जाएगा । उपर्युक्त का प्रभाव दिखाने के लिए आवश्यक समायोजन प्रविष्टि होगी :
sub_questions.text_english: (a) Dan, Elf and Furhan were partners in a firm sharing profits in the ratio of 5:3:2. With effect from 1st April, 2023, they decided to change their profit sharing ratio to 2:3:5. There existed a General Reserve of ₹ 90,000 on the date of change in profit sharing ratio. The partners decided not to distribute General Reserve. The necessary adjustment entry to show the effect of the above will be:

options.A: Dan's Capital A/c Dr. 27,000; To Furhan's Capital A/c 27,000
options.B: Dan's Capital A/c Dr. 90,000; To Furhan's Capital A/c 90,000
options.C: Furhan's Capital A/c Dr. 27,000; To Dan's Capital A/c 27,000
options.D: Furhan's Capital A/c Dr. 90,000; To Dan's Capital A/c 90,000

options_english.A: Dan's Capital A/c Dr. 27,000; To Furhan's Capital A/c 27,000
options_english.B: Dan's Capital A/c Dr. 90,000; To Furhan's Capital A/c 90,000
options_english.C: Furhan's Capital A/c Dr. 27,000; To Dan's Capital A/c 27,000
options_english.D: Furhan's Capital A/c Dr. 90,000; To Dan's Capital A/c 90,000

sub_questions.solution: When partners decide not to distribute a reserve, an adjustment entry is passed by debiting the gaining partner and crediting the sacrificing partner. Dan's sacrifice = 5/10 - 2/10 = 3/10. Elf's sacrifice = 3/10 - 3/10 = 0. Furhan's sacrifice = 2/10 - 5/10 = -3/10 (Gain). The adjustment amount is ₹90,000 multiplied by the 3/10 gained/sacrificed, giving ₹27,000. Hence, Furhan's Capital is debited by ₹27,000 and Dan's is credited by ₹27,000.

sub_questions.text: (ख) सिया, टॉम तथा विधि एक फर्म में साझेदार थे तथा 3:2:1 के अनुपात में लाभों का विभाजन करते थे । 1 अप्रैल, 2023 से उन्होंने भविष्य में लाभ-हानि का विभाजन 1:2:3 के अनुपात में करने का निर्णय लिया। उस तिथि को लाभ-हानि खाते में ₹ 60,000 का नाम शेष था । लाभ-हानि खाते के शेष को बाँटने के लिए आवश्यक रोज़नामचा प्रविष्टि होगी :
sub_questions.text_english: (b) Sia, Tom and Vidhi were partners in a firm sharing profits in the ratio of 3:2:1. With effect from 1st April, 2023, they decided to share profits and losses in the future in the ratio of 1:2:3. There existed a Debit Balance of ₹ 60,000 in Profit and Loss Account on that date. The necessary journal entry for distribution of the balance in the Profit and Loss Account will be :

options.A: Sia's Capital A/c Dr 30,000; Tom's Capital A/c Dr 20,000; Vidhi's Capital A/c Dr 10,000; To Profit and Loss A/c 60,000
options.B: Sia's Capital A/c Dr 10,000; Tom's Capital A/c Dr 20,000; Vidhi's Capital A/c Dr 30,000; To Profit and Loss A/c 60,000
options.C: Sia's Capital A/c Dr 20,000; To Vidhi's Capital A/c 20,000
options.D: Vidhi's Capital A/c Dr 20,000; To Sia's Capital A/c 20,000

options_english.A: Sia's Capital A/c Dr 30,000; Tom's Capital A/c Dr 20,000; Vidhi's Capital A/c Dr 10,000; To Profit and Loss A/c 60,000
options_english.B: Sia's Capital A/c Dr 10,000; Tom's Capital A/c Dr 20,000; Vidhi's Capital A/c Dr 30,000; To Profit and Loss A/c 60,000
options_english.C: Sia's Capital A/c Dr 20,000; To Vidhi's Capital A/c 20,000
options_english.D: Vidhi's Capital A/c Dr 20,000; To Sia's Capital A/c 20,000

sub_questions.solution: A debit balance in the Profit and Loss Account represents accumulated losses. Unless specified otherwise, these accumulated losses must be completely written off by debiting the partners' capital accounts in their old profit-sharing ratio (3:2:1) prior to the reconstitution. Therefore, the ₹60,000 loss is distributed as Sia: ₹30,000, Tom: ₹20,000, and Vidhi: ₹10,000.

questions.text:
ज़ीनो लिमिटेड ने ₹ 10 प्रत्येक के 25,000 समता अंश/शेयर निर्गमित किए । राशि का भुगतान निम्न प्रकार से करना था :
आवेदन पर ₹ 4 प्रति अंश/शेयर
आबंटन पर ₹5 प्रति अंश/शेयर
प्रथम एवं अंतिम याचना पर शेष
प्रस्तावित सभी अंशों/शेयरों के लिए आवेदन प्राप्त हुए और आबंटित कर दिए गए । 1,500 अंशों/शेयरों को छोड़कर आबंटन पर देय समस्त धनराशि प्राप्त हो गईं। आबंटन के तुरंत बाद इन अंशों/शेयरों का हरण (forfeit) कर लिया गया । प्रथम एवं अंतिम याचना अभी तक माँगी नहीं गई थी। अंश/शेयर हरण (forfeit) के समय अंश/शेयर पूँजी खाते में नाम किए जाएँगे :
questions.text_english:
Xeno Ltd. issued 25,000 equity shares of ₹ 10 each. The amount was payable as follows:
On Application ₹ 4 per share
On Allotment ₹ 5 per share
On First and Final call Balance
All the shares offered were applied for and allotted. All the money due on allotment was received except on 1,500 shares. These shares were forfeited immediately after allotment. First and final call was not yet made. At the time of forfeiture, Share Capital Account will be debited by :
questions.solution: When shares are forfeited, the Share Capital Account is debited with the called-up value of the shares up to the point of forfeiture. In this case, the called-up amount includes the application money (₹4) and the allotment money (₹5), making the called-up value ₹9 per share. For 1,500 forfeited shares, the Share Capital account will be debited by 1,500 multiplied by ₹9, which is ₹13,500.
questions.solution_hindi: जब अंशों का हरण किया जाता है, तो अंश पूंजी खाते को हरण के समय तक अंशों के मांगे गए (called-up) मूल्य से नाम (debit) किया जाता है। इस मामले में, मांगी गई राशि में आवेदन राशि (₹4) और आबंटन राशि (₹5) शामिल है, जिससे प्रति अंश मांगा गया मूल्य ₹9 हो जाता है। 1,500 हरण किए गए अंशों के लिए, अंश पूंजी खाते को 1,500 गुना ₹9 से नाम किया जाएगा, जो कि ₹13,500 है।

sub_questions.text_english: (a) Atul, Beena and Sita were partners in a firm sharing profits and losses in the ratio of 8:7:5. Damini was admitted as a new partner for 1/5th share in the profits which she acquired entirely from Atul. The new profit sharing ratio after Damini's admission will be:
sub_questions.solution: Damini acquires her entire 1/5th share (which is equivalent to 4/20) from Atul. Atul's original share was 8/20, so his new share becomes 8/20 - 4/20 = 4/20. Beena and Sita retain their original shares of 7/20 and 5/20 respectively, making the new profit sharing ratio 4:7:5:4.

sub_questions.text_english: (b) Rushil and Abheer were partners in a firm sharing profits and losses in the ratio of 4: 3. They admitted Sunil as a new partner for 3/7th share in the profits of firm, which he acquired 2/7th share from Rushil and 1/7th share from Abheer. The new profit sharing ratio of Rushil, Abheer and Sunil will be :
sub_questions.solution: Sunil receives 2/7 from Rushil and 1/7 from Abheer. Rushil's new share is 4/7 - 2/7 = 2/7. Abheer's new share is 3/7 - 1/7 = 2/7. Therefore, the new profit sharing ratio among Rushil, Abheer, and Sunil is 2:2:3.

questions.text_english: Alfa Ltd. invited applications for 50,000 equity shares of ₹ 10 each at a premium of 30%. The whole amount was payable on application. Applications were received for 2,50,000 shares. The company decided to allot the shares on a pro-rata basis to all the applicants. The amount refunded by the company was:
questions.solution: The total issue price is ₹13 per share (₹10 face value plus ₹3 premium), and it was fully payable on application. The company received applications for 2,50,000 shares but can only allot a maximum of 50,000 shares. Since the entire amount was collected on application, all money received for the unallotted shares (2,50,000 - 50,000 = 2,00,000 shares) must be refunded directly. The refund amount is 2,00,000 shares multiplied by ₹13, which equals ₹26,00,000.
questions.solution_hindi: प्रति अंश कुल निर्गम मूल्य ₹13 है (₹10 अंकित मूल्य और ₹3 प्रीमियम), और इसका पूरा भुगतान आवेदन पर देय था। कंपनी को 2,50,000 अंशों के लिए आवेदन प्राप्त हुए लेकिन वह केवल 50,000 अंश ही आबंटित कर सकती है। चूंकि पूरी राशि आवेदन पर ही प्राप्त हो गई थी, इसलिए बिना आबंटित अंशों (2,50,000 - 50,000 = 2,00,000 अंश) के लिए प्राप्त सभी धन को सीधे वापस किया जाना चाहिए। धनवापसी की राशि 2,00,000 अंशों को ₹13 से गुणा करने पर ₹26,00,000 प्राप्त होती है।

questions.text:
अभिकथन (A) : अमोचनीय (अशोध्य) ऋणपत्रों को स्थायी ऋणपत्रों के नाम से भी जाना जाता है ।
कारण (R) : कम्पनी इस प्रकार के ऋणपत्रों के निर्गमन द्वारा उधार प्राप्त द्रव्य के परिशोधन के लिए भी कोई वचन नहीं देती है। ये ऋणपत्र कम्पनी की समाप्ति पर या एक दीर्घकालिक अवधि के समापन पर शोधनीय होते हैं ।
निम्नलिखित में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
questions.text_english:
Assertion (A): Irredeemable debentures are also known as perpetual debentures.
Reason (R): The company does not give any undertaking for the repayment of money borrowed by issuing such debentures. They are repayable on the winding up of the company or on the expiry of a long period.
Choose the correct option from the following:

options.A: अभिकथन (A) तथा कारण (R) दोनों सही हैं तथा कारण (R) अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या है ।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) तथा कारण (R) दोनों सही हैं, लेकिन कारण (R) अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं है।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) ग़लत है, लेकिन कारण (R) सही है ।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) सही है, लेकिन कारण (R) ग़लत है ।

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are correct and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are correct, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is incorrect, but Reason (R) is correct.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is correct, but Reason (R) is incorrect.

questions.solution: Irredeemable debentures are indeed termed perpetual debentures precisely because the issuing company makes no commitment to repay the principal amount during its operational lifetime. Repayment only occurs upon the liquidation of the company, making the Reason a perfectly accurate explanation for the Assertion.
questions.solution_hindi: अमोचनीय ऋणपत्रों को वास्तव में स्थायी ऋणपत्र कहा जाता है क्योंकि जारीकर्ता कंपनी अपने परिचालन जीवनकाल के दौरान मूल राशि चुकाने की कोई प्रतिबद्धता नहीं देती है। पुनर्भुगतान केवल कंपनी के समापन पर होता है, जिससे कारण (R) अभिकथन (A) की पूरी तरह से सही व्याख्या बन जाता है।

questions.text:
आभा तथा बबीता मिट्टी से खिलौने बनाने वाली एक फर्म की साझेदार थीं तथा 2:1 के अनुपात में लाभों का विभाजन करती थीं । 1 अप्रैल, 2023 को उनके पूँजी खाते क्रमशः ₹5,00,000 तथा ₹ 10,00,000 के शेष दर्शा रहे थे। साझेदारी संलेख में 10% वार्षिक दर से पूँजी पर ब्याज देने का प्रावधान था । फर्म ने वर्ष के दौरान ₹90,000 का लाभ अर्जित किया ।
आभा को दिए जाने वाली पूँजी पर ब्याज की राशि होगी :
questions.text_english:
Read the following hypothetical situation and answer questions No. 7 and 8 on the basis of the given information.
Abha and Babita were partners in a clay toy making firm sharing profits in the ratio of 2: 1. On 1st April, 2023, their capital accounts showed balances of ₹5,00,000 and ₹10,00,000 respectively. The partnership deed provides for interest on capital @ 10% p.a. The firm earned a profit of ₹90,000 during the year.
The amount of interest on capital allowed to Abha will be :
questions.solution: The interest on capital calculated at 10% for Abha is ₹50,000 and for Babita is ₹1,00,000, bringing the total interest claim to ₹1,50,000. However, the firm's available profit is only ₹90,000. Because available profits are less than the total interest claim, the profit must be distributed in the ratio of their interest claims (50,000 : 1,00,000 = 1:2). Thus, Abha receives 1/3rd of ₹90,000, which is ₹30,000.
questions.solution_hindi: आभा के लिए 10% की दर से पूंजी पर ब्याज ₹50,000 और बबीता के लिए ₹1,00,000 है, जिससे कुल ब्याज का दावा ₹1,50,000 हो जाता है। हालांकि, फर्म का उपलब्ध लाभ केवल ₹90,000 है। क्योंकि उपलब्ध लाभ कुल ब्याज के दावे से कम है, इसलिए लाभ को उनके ब्याज के दावों के अनुपात (50,000 : 1,00,000 = 1:2) में वितरित किया जाना चाहिए। इस प्रकार, आभा को ₹90,000 का 1/3 हिस्सा मिलेगा, जो ₹30,000 है।

questions.text: अभय, बोरिस तथा चेतन एक फर्म में साझेदार थे तथा 5:3:2 के अनुपात में लाभों का विभाजन करते थे । बोरिस को लाभ में ₹ 95,000 की गारंटी दी गई। इसके कारण हुई किसी भी कमी को अभय तथा चेतन बराबर-बराबर वहन करेंगे। 31 मार्च, 2023 को समाप्त हुए वर्ष में, फर्म ने ₹ 2,00,000 का लाभ अर्जित किया। अभय द्वारा बोरिस को उसकी गारंटी की राशि के रूप में दी गई राशि होगी :
questions.text_english: Abhay, Boris and Chetan were partners in a firm sharing profits in the ratio of 5:3: 2. Boris was guaranteed a profit of ₹ 95,000. Any deficiency on account of this was to be borne by Abhay and Chetan equally. The firm earned a profit of ₹ 2,00,000 for the year ended 31st March, 2023. The amount given by Abhay to Boris as guaranteed amount will be:
questions.solution: Boris's share of the actual profit is 3/10 of ₹2,00,000, which equals ₹60,000. His guaranteed minimum profit is ₹95,000, creating a deficiency of ₹35,000. This deficiency is borne equally by Abhay and Chetan, meaning Abhay must contribute half of it, which amounts to ₹17,500.
questions.solution_hindi: बोरिस का वास्तविक लाभ में हिस्सा ₹2,00,000 का 3/10, यानी ₹60,000 है। उसकी गारंटी की राशि ₹95,000 है, जिससे ₹35,000 की कमी उत्पन्न होती है। यह कमी अभय और चेतन द्वारा समान रूप से वहन की जानी है, इसलिए अभय द्वारा दी जाने वाली राशि ₹17,500 होगी।

questions.text: पियूष, राजेश तथा अविनाश एक फर्म में साझेदार थे तथा लाभ-हानि का विभाजन बराबर-बराबर करते थे। शिवा को बराबर के भाग के लिए एक नए साझेदार के रूप में प्रवेश दिया गया । शिवा अपने भाग की पूँजी तथा ख्याति प्रीमियम नगद लाया । ख्याति प्रीमियम की राशि को विभाजित किया जाएगा :
questions.text_english: Piyush, Rajesh and Avinash were partners in a firm sharing profits and losses equally. Shiva was admitted as a new partner for an equal share. Shiva brought his share of capital and premium for goodwill in cash. The premium for goodwill amount will be divided among :

options.A: पुराने साझेदारों के बीच पुराने अनुपात में
options.B: नए साझेदारों के बीच नए अनुपात में
options.C: नए साझेदारों के बीच त्याग अनुपात में
options.D: पुराने साझेदारों के बीच त्याग अनुपात में

questions.solution: When a new partner brings in their share of the premium for goodwill in cash, this amount serves as compensation to the existing partners for the profit share they have relinquished. Therefore, it is always distributed among the old partners in their sacrificing ratio.
questions.solution_hindi: जब कोई नया साझेदार नकद में ख्याति के लिए प्रीमियम का अपना हिस्सा लाता है, तो यह राशि मौजूदा साझेदारों को उनके द्वारा छोड़े गए लाभ के हिस्से के लिए मुआवजे के रूप में कार्य करती है। इसलिए, इसे हमेशा पुराने साझेदारों के बीच उनके त्याग अनुपात में विभाजित किया जाता है।

questions.text:
अभिकथन (A) : प्रत्येक साझेदार प्रमुख होने के साथ-साथ दूसरे सभी साझेदारों के लिए एक अभिकर्ता भी है ।
कारण (R) : साझेदारी अधिनियम की परिभाषा के अनुसार, साझेदारी व्यवसाय सभी साझेदारों द्वारा या सभी की ओर से उनमें से किसी एक के द्वारा चलाया जा सकता है ।
निम्नलिखित में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
questions.text_english:
Assertion (A): Each partner is a principal as well as an agent for all the other partners.
Reason (R): As per the definition of Partnership Act, partnership business may be carried on by all the partners or any of them acting for all.
Choose the correct option from the following:

options.A: अभिकथन (A) तथा कारण (R) दोनों सही हैं, लेकिन कारण (R) अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं है।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) तथा कारण (R) दोनों सही हैं तथा कारण (R) अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या है ।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सही है, लेकिन कारण (R) ग़लत है ।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) ग़लत है, लेकिन कारण (R) सही है।

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are correct, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are correct and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is correct, but Reason (R) is incorrect.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is incorrect, but Reason (R) is correct.

questions.solution: The mutual agency concept under the Partnership Act establishes that every partner operates as both an agent (binding others by their acts) and a principal (being bound by the acts of others). The Reason correctly defines this legal framework by stating that the business can be carried on by all or any of them acting for all, which directly explains the Assertion.
questions.solution_hindi: साझेदारी अधिनियम के तहत पारस्परिक एजेंसी की अवधारणा यह स्थापित करती है कि प्रत्येक साझेदार एक अभिकर्ता (अपने कार्यों द्वारा दूसरों को बाध्य करने वाला) और एक प्रमुख (दूसरों के कार्यों से बाध्य होने वाला) दोनों के रूप में कार्य करता है। कारण (R) सही ढंग से इस कानूनी ढांचे को परिभाषित करता है कि व्यवसाय सभी द्वारा या उन सभी की ओर से कार्य करने वाले किसी भी व्यक्ति द्वारा चलाया जा सकता है, जो सीधे अभिकथन (A) की व्याख्या करता है।

questions.text: संचित (आरक्षित) पूँजी, ________ पूँजी का वह भाग है, जिसे केवल कम्पनी की समापन दशा के अतिरिक्त माँगा नहीं जा सकता ।
questions.text_english: Reserve capital is that part of ________ capital which cannot be called except at the time of winding up of the company.
questions.solution: Reserve capital represents the specific portion of a company's uncalled capital that the company has formally resolved not to call up except in the event of its winding up, essentially reserving it for the protection of its creditors.
questions.solution_hindi: संचित (आरक्षित) पूंजी, कंपनी की अयाचित (Uncalled) पूंजी के उस विशिष्ट हिस्से का प्रतिनिधित्व करती है जिसे कंपनी ने औपचारिक रूप से यह निर्णय लिया है कि उसे कंपनी के समापन के अलावा अन्य किसी समय नहीं मांगा जाएगा, इसे मूलतः लेनदारों की सुरक्षा के लिए सुरक्षित रखा जाता है।

sub_questions.text_english: (a) Anju, Divya and Bobby were partners in a firm sharing profits and losses in the ratio of 3:2: 1. Bobby retired. The new profit sharing ratio between Anju and Divya after Bobby's retirement was 5:3. The gaining ratio of remaining partners will be :
sub_questions.solution: The gaining ratio is calculated by subtracting the old share from the new share. For Anju, the gain is 5/8 - 3/6 = (15 - 12)/24 = 3/24. For Divya, the gain is 3/8 - 2/6 = (9 - 8)/24 = 1/24. Thus, their respective gains are in the ratio of 3/24 to 1/24, simplifying cleanly to a gaining ratio of 3:1.

sub_questions.text: (ख) मीता, वीना तथा अतुल एक फर्म में साझेदार थे तथा 3:2:1 के अनुपात में लाभ-हानि का विभाजन करते थे । अतुल सेवानिवृत्त हो गया और उसका भाग मीता तथा वीना द्वारा 1:4 के अनुपात में ले लिया गया । अतुल की सेवानिवृत्ति के बाद मीता तथा वीना का नया लाभ-विभाजन अनुपात होगा :
sub_questions.text_english: (b) Mita, Veena and Atul were partners in a firm sharing profits and losses in the ratio of 3:2:1. Atul retired and his share was taken over by Mita and Veena in the ratio of 1: 4. The new profit sharing ratio between Mita and Veena after Atul's retirement will be:
sub_questions.solution: Atul's share upon retirement is 1/6. This is taken by Mita and Veena in a 1:4 ratio. Mita gains 1/6 × 1/5 = 1/30. Veena gains 1/6 × 4/5 = 4/30. Adding these gains to their original shares: Mita's new share is 3/6 + 1/30 = 16/30. Veena's new share is 2/6 + 4/30 = 14/30. The new ratio therefore becomes 16:14, which simplifies to 8:7.

questions.text: आव्या, मितांश तथा प्रवीन एक फर्म में साझेदार थे। 31 मार्च, 2023 को फर्म का विघटन हो गया । लेनदारों ने ₹ 50,000 पुस्तक मूल्य के फर्नीचर को उनके ₹ 60,000 की राशि के आंशिक निपटारे के रूप में ₹ 45,000 में ले लिया। शेष राशि का भुगतान उन्हें चैक द्वारा किया गया । चैक द्वारा भुगतान की जाने वाली राशि होगी :
questions.text_english: Aavya, Mitansh and Praveen were partners in a firm. On 31st March, 2023, the firm was dissolved. Creditors took over furniture of book value of ₹ 50,000 at ₹ 45,000 in part settlement of their amount of ₹ 60,000. The balance amount was paid to them through cheque. The amount paid through cheque will be :
questions.solution: The total amount owed to the creditors was ₹60,000. They accepted furniture valued at ₹45,000 for part settlement of their claim. The remaining balance to be paid by cheque is the difference between the total claim and the settlement value of the asset taken over, which is ₹60,000 minus ₹45,000, equalling ₹15,000.
questions.solution_hindi: लेनदारों की कुल देय राशि ₹60,000 थी। उन्होंने अपने दावों के आंशिक निपटारे के रूप में ₹45,000 मूल्य का फर्नीचर स्वीकार किया। शेष राशि जो चेक द्वारा भुगतान की जानी है, कुल देय राशि और ली गई संपत्ति के मूल्य का अंतर है, जो ₹60,000 - ₹45,000 = ₹15,000 है।

questions.text: एलेक्स, बैन तथा कोल एक फर्म में साझेदार थे तथा 5:3:2 के अनुपात में लाभ-हानि विभाजित करते थे । उन्होंने डोना को भावी लाभों में 1/5 भाग के लिए एक नए साझेदार के रूप में प्रवेश दिया । डोना आनुपातिक पूँजी देने के लिए सहमत हो गई। प्रवेश की तिथि पर एलेक्स, बैन तथा कोल की पूँजी, सभी समायोजनों के पश्चात् क्रमशः ₹ 1,20,000, ₹ 80,000 तथा ₹ 1,00,000 थी। डोना द्वारा लाई गई पूँजी की राशि होगी :
questions.text_english: Alex, Benn and Cole were partners in a firm sharing profits and losses in the ratio of 5:3:2. They admitted Dona as a new partner for 1/5th share in the future profits. Dona agreed to contribute proportionate capital. On the date of admission, capitals of Alex, Benn and Cole after all adjustments were ₹ 1,20,000; ₹ 80,000 and ₹ 1,00,000 respectively. The amount of capital brought in by Dona will be :
questions.solution: The combined adjusted capital of the old partners (Alex, Benn, and Cole) is ₹1,20,000 + ₹80,000 + ₹1,00,000 = ₹3,00,000. Since Dona is admitted for a 1/5th share, the old partners retain a 4/5th share of the firm. Therefore, the total capital of the firm is calculated as ₹3,00,000 multiplied by the reciprocal of their share (5/4), which equals ₹3,75,000. Dona's proportionate capital contribution is 1/5th of the total firm capital, which is ₹75,000.
questions.solution_hindi: पुराने साझेदारों (एलेक्स, बैन और कोल) की कुल समायोजित पूंजी ₹1,20,000 + ₹80,000 + ₹1,00,000 = ₹3,00,000 है। चूंकि डोना को 1/5 भाग के लिए प्रवेश दिया गया है, इसलिए पुराने साझेदारों के पास फर्म का 4/5 भाग शेष रहता है। इसलिए, फर्म की कुल पूंजी ₹3,00,000 को उनके हिस्से के व्युत्क्रम (5/4) से गुणा करके निकाली जाती है, जो ₹3,75,000 है। डोना का आनुपातिक पूंजी योगदान कुल फर्म पूंजी का 1/5 वां हिस्सा है, जो ₹75,000 है।

questions.text:
अनमोल, बादल तथा चीनू एक फर्म में साझेदार थे तथा 5:4:3 के अनुपात में लाभ-हानि का विभाजन करते थे । बादल सेवानिवृत्त हो गया । अनमोल तथा चीनू ने भविष्य में लाभ-हानि का विभाजन 1:2 के अनुपात में करने का निर्णय लिया। बादल की सेवानिवृत्ति के दिन फर्म की ख्याति का मूल्यांकन ₹ 1,20,000 किया गया ।
अधिलाभ अनुपात की गणना कीजिए तथा बादल की सेवानिवृत्ति पर ख्याति का लेखा (ख्याति खाता खोले बिना) करने के लिए आवश्यक रोज़नामचा प्रविष्टि कीजिए ।
questions.text_english:
Anmol, Badal and Cheenu were partners in a firm sharing profits and losses in the ratio of 5:4:3. Badal retired. Anmol and Cheenu decided to share profits and losses in future in the ratio of 1:2. On the day of Badal's retirement, goodwill of the firm was valued at ₹ 1,20,000.
Calculate gaining ratio and pass necessary journal entry to record the treatment of goodwill (without opening goodwill account), on Badal's retirement.

key_points: Old ratio = 5:4:3. New ratio = 1:2.
Anmol's gain = 1/3 - 5/12 = -1/12 (Sacrifice). Cheenu's gain = 2/3 - 3/12 = 5/12.
Firm Goodwill = 1,20,000. Badal's share = 4/12 * 1,20,000 = 40,000.
Entry: Cheenu's Capital A/c Dr 50,000 To Badal's Capital A/c 40,000 To Anmol's Capital A/c 10,000.

questions.solution: First, compute the gaining ratio. The old ratio among Anmol, Badal, and Cheenu was 5:4:3, making their old shares 5/12, 4/12, and 3/12 respectively. Badal retires, and the new ratio for Anmol and Cheenu is 1:2. Anmol's gain is 1/3 - 5/12 = -1/12, meaning Anmol actually sacrifices. Cheenu's gain is 2/3 - 3/12 = 5/12. Therefore, Cheenu is the sole gaining partner. The firm's goodwill is valued at ₹1,20,000. Retiring Badal must be compensated for his 4/12 share, which is ₹40,000. Anmol must also be compensated for her 1/12 sacrifice, which equates to ₹10,000. Cheenu bears the entire burden for his 5/12 gain, which is ₹50,000. The required adjusting journal entry is to debit Cheenu's Capital Account for ₹50,000, and correspondingly credit Badal's Capital Account for ₹40,000 and Anmol's Capital Account for ₹10,000.
questions.solution_hindi: सबसे पहले, अधिलाभ (gaining) अनुपात की गणना करें। अनमोल, बादल और चीनू के बीच पुराना अनुपात 5:4:3 था, जिससे उनके पुराने हिस्से क्रमशः 5/12, 4/12 और 3/12 हो गए। बादल सेवानिवृत्त होता है, और अनमोल और चीनू का नया अनुपात 1:2 है। अनमोल का लाभ 1/3 - 5/12 = -1/12 है, जिसका अर्थ है कि अनमोल वास्तव में त्याग करती है। चीनू का लाभ 2/3 - 3/12 = 5/12 है। इसलिए, चीनू एकमात्र लाभ प्राप्त करने वाला भागीदार है। फर्म की ख्याति का मूल्यांकन ₹1,20,000 किया गया है। सेवानिवृत्त होने वाले बादल को उसके 4/12 हिस्से के लिए मुआवजा दिया जाना चाहिए, जो ₹40,000 है। अनमोल को उसके 1/12 त्याग के लिए भी मुआवजा दिया जाना चाहिए, जो ₹10,000 के बराबर है। चीनू अपने 5/12 लाभ के लिए पूरा बोझ उठाता है, जो ₹50,000 है। आवश्यक समायोजन रोजनामचा प्रविष्टि चीनू के पूंजी खाते को ₹50,000 से डेबिट करने और तदनुसार बादल के पूंजी खाते को ₹40,000 और अनमोल के पूंजी खाते को ₹10,000 से क्रेडिट करने की है।

questions.text:
प्रान तथा रोन एक फर्म में साझेदार थे तथा उनकी संयुक्त पूँजी ₹3,00,000 थी । प्रतिफल की सामान्य दर 15% थी। पिछले चार वर्षों के लाभ निम्न प्रकार थे :
2019-20 ₹ 50,000
2020-21 ₹ 90,000
2021-22 ₹ 80,000
2022-23 ₹ 70,000
वर्ष 2022 - 23 के अंतिम रहतिए (स्टॉक) का मूल्यांकन ₹ 10,000 से कम किया गया ।
अधिलाभ की पूँजीकरण विधि के आधार पर फर्म की ख्याति की गणना कीजिए ।
questions.text_english:
Pran and Ron were partners in a firm with a combined capital of ₹ 3,00,000. The normal rate of return was 15%. The profits of the last four years were as follows:
2019-20 ₹ 50,000
2020-21 ₹ 90,000
2021-22 ₹ 80,000
2022-23 ₹ 70,000
The closing stock for the year 2022-23 was undervalued by ₹ 10,000.
Calculate goodwill of the firm based on capitalisation of super profit.

key_points: Normal Profit = 15% of 3,00,000 = 45,000.
Super Profit = Average Actual Profit - Normal Profit = 75,000 - 45,000 = 30,000.
Goodwill = Super Profit × (100 / Normal Rate of Return) = 30,000 × (100 / 15) = 2,00,000.

questions.solution: Begin by finding the corrected profits. The 2022-23 closing stock was undervalued by ₹10,000, which artificially reduced that year's stated profit. We add it back: ₹70,000 + ₹10,000 = ₹80,000. Now, calculate the average actual profit over the four years: (₹50,000 + ₹90,000 + ₹80,000 + ₹80,000) / 4 = ₹3,00,000 / 4 = ₹75,000. Next, calculate the normal profit based on the capital employed. Normal Profit = 15% of ₹3,00,000 = ₹45,000. The super profit is the excess of average actual profit over normal profit: ₹75,000 - ₹45,000 = ₹30,000. Finally, using the capitalization of super profit method, Goodwill = Super Profit × (100 / Normal Rate of Return) = ₹30,000 × (100 / 15), which yields a firm goodwill of ₹2,00,000.
questions.solution_hindi: सही लाभ ज्ञात करके शुरुआत करें। 2022-23 का अंतिम स्टॉक ₹10,000 कम आंका गया था, जिससे उस वर्ष का कथित लाभ कृत्रिम रूप से कम हो गया। हम इसे वापस जोड़ते हैं: ₹70,000 + ₹10,000 = ₹80,000। अब, चार वर्षों में औसत वास्तविक लाभ की गणना करें: (₹50,000 + ₹90,000 + ₹80,000 + ₹80,000) / 4 = ₹3,00,000 / 4 = ₹75,000। इसके बाद, नियोजित पूंजी के आधार पर सामान्य लाभ की गणना करें। सामान्य लाभ = ₹3,00,000 का 15% = ₹45,000। अधिलाभ (super profit) सामान्य लाभ पर औसत वास्तविक लाभ की अधिकता है: ₹75,000 - ₹45,000 = ₹30,000। अंत में, अधिलाभ के पूंजीकरण की विधि का उपयोग करते हुए, ख्याति = अधिलाभ × (100 / सामान्य प्रतिफल दर) = ₹30,000 × (100 / 15), जिससे फर्म की ख्याति ₹2,00,000 प्राप्त होती है।

sub_questions.text_english: (a) Sunrise Ltd. acquired assets of ₹ 3,60,000 and took over creditors of ₹ 1,00,000 from Moonlight Ltd. for an agreed purchase consideration of ₹ 4,80,000. Sunrise Ltd. issued 9% Debentures of ₹ 100 each at a discount of 4% in satisfaction of the purchase consideration. Pass necessary journal entries in the books of Sunrise Ltd. Show your workings clearly.

key_points: Goodwill calculation: Purchase Consideration (4,80,000) + Liabilities (1,00,000) - Assets (3,60,000) = Goodwill (2,20,000).
Entry 1: Assets A/c Dr 3,60,000, Goodwill A/c Dr 2,20,000 To Creditors A/c 1,00,000 To Moonlight Ltd 4,80,000.
Number of debentures to be issued = 4,80,000 / 96 = 5,000 debentures.
Entry 2: Moonlight Ltd Dr 4,80,000, Discount on Issue of Debentures A/c Dr 20,000 To 9% Debentures A/c 5,00,000.

sub_questions.solution: When Sunrise Ltd. acquired the business, the net assets taken over amounted to ₹2,60,000 (Assets of ₹3,60,000 minus Creditors of ₹1,00,000). Given the purchase consideration was agreed at ₹4,80,000, the excess amount paid of ₹2,20,000 is recognised as Goodwill. The first entry debits Assets (₹3,60,000) and Goodwill (₹2,20,000), and credits Creditors (₹1,00,000) and Moonlight Ltd. (₹4,80,000). For the payment, the debentures are issued at a 4% discount, making the issue price ₹96 per debenture. Dividing the liability of ₹4,80,000 by ₹96 reveals that exactly 5,000 debentures must be issued. The settlement entry will thus debit Moonlight Ltd. for ₹4,80,000, debit Discount on Issue of Debentures for ₹20,000, and heavily credit 9% Debentures Account for their full face value of ₹5,00,000.

sub_questions.text: (ख) ग्रेपल लिमिटेड ने ऐलोर लिमिटेड से ₹ 18,00,000 के सहमत क्रय मूल्य पर ₹ 25,00,000 की परिसम्पत्तियों तथा ₹ 5,00,000 की देयताओं का अधिग्रहण किया । क्रय मूल्य के भुगतान स्वरूप ग्रेपल लिमिटेड ने ₹ 100 प्रत्येक के 11% ऋणपत्रों को 20% प्रीमियम पर निर्गमन किया । ग्रेपल लिमिटेड की पुस्तकों में आवश्यक रोज़नामचा प्रविष्टियाँ कीजिए । अपने कार्य को स्पष्टता से दर्शाइए ।
sub_questions.text_english: (b) Grapple Ltd. took over assets of ₹ 25,00,000 and liabilities of ₹ 5,00,000 from Allore Ltd. for an agreed purchase consideration of ₹ 18,00,000. Grapple Ltd. issued 11% Debentures of ₹ 100 each at 20% premium in satisfaction of the purchase consideration. Pass necessary journal entries in the books of Grapple Ltd. Show your workings clearly.

key_points: Capital Reserve calculation: Assets (25,00,000) - Liabilities (5,00,000) - Purchase Consideration (18,00,000) = Capital Reserve (2,00,000).
Entry 1: Assets A/c Dr 25,00,000 To Liabilities A/c 5,00,000 To Allore Ltd 18,00,000 To Capital Reserve A/c 2,00,000.
Number of debentures to be issued = 18,00,000 / 120 = 15,000 debentures.
Entry 2: Allore Ltd Dr 18,00,000 To 11% Debentures A/c 15,00,000 To Securities Premium Reserve A/c 3,00,000.

sub_questions.solution: Upon taking over the business from Allore Ltd., Grapple Ltd. received net assets worth ₹20,00,000 (Assets of ₹25,00,000 minus Liabilities of ₹5,00,000). Since the purchase consideration was aggressively negotiated down to just ₹18,00,000, the remaining ₹2,00,000 represents a clear capital profit and is transferred to the Capital Reserve. The first entry debits Assets for ₹25,00,000, and credits Liabilities (₹5,00,000), Allore Ltd. (₹18,00,000), and Capital Reserve (₹2,00,000). For the discharge of purchase consideration, debentures are issued at a 20% premium, resulting in an issue price of ₹120 each. Dividing ₹18,00,000 by ₹120 gives exactly 15,000 debentures. The payment entry cleanly debits Allore Ltd. for ₹18,00,000, and credits 11% Debentures for ₹15,00,000 alongside a credit to Securities Premium Reserve for the ₹3,00,000 premium collected.

sub_questions.text_english: (a) Mohan, Suhaan and Adit were partners in a firm sharing profits and losses in the ratio of 3:2:1. Their fixed capitals were: ₹ 2,00,000, ₹ 1,00,000 and ₹ 1,00,000 respectively. For the year ended 31st March, 2023, interest on capital was credited to their accounts @ 8% p.a. instead of 5% p.a. Pass necessary adjusting journal entry. Show your workings clearly.

key_points: Excess interest credited = 3% p.a. (Mohan 6,000, Suhaan 3,000, Adit 3,000). Total excess = 12,000.
This 12,000 represents profit that should have been distributed in 3:2:1 ratio (Mohan 6,000, Suhaan 4,000, Adit 2,000).
Net effect: Mohan (Dr 6,000, Cr 6,000 = Nil). Suhaan (Dr 3,000, Cr 4,000 = Cr 1,000). Adit (Dr 3,000, Cr 2,000 = Dr 1,000).
Entry is passed through Current Accounts as capitals are fixed.
Entry: Adit's Current A/c Dr 1,000 To Suhaan's Current A/c 1,000.

sub_questions.solution: The partners were incorrectly credited with 8% interest on capital instead of the required 5%, resulting in an excess credit of 3%. The excess interest wrongfully credited to their accounts is ₹6,000 for Mohan, ₹3,000 for Suhaan, and ₹3,000 for Adit, aggregating to ₹12,000. This ₹12,000 should have been standard profit and distributed in their correct profit-sharing ratio of 3:2:1, which equates to right credits of ₹6,000 to Mohan, ₹4,000 to Suhaan, and ₹2,000 to Adit. Contrasting the wrongful credits against the rightful ones reveals Mohan's balance is unaffected, Suhaan should be credited an additional ₹1,000, and Adit must be debited by ₹1,000. Since capitals are explicitly stated as fixed, current accounts are strictly used. The final adjustment entry will debit Adit’s Current Account for ₹1,000 and logically credit Suhaan’s Current Account for ₹1,000.

sub_questions.text: (ख) मनोज एवं नितिन एक फर्म में साझेदार थे तथा 2:1 के अनुपात में लाभ-हानि का विभाजन करते थे । 31 मार्च, 2023 को लाभ एवं आहरण का समायोजन करने के पश्चात् उनके पूँजी खातों का शेष क्रमशः ₹ 90,000 तथा ₹ 80,000 था । 31 मार्च, 2023 को समाप्त हुए वर्ष के लिए शुद्ध लाभ की राशि ₹ 30,000 थी । वर्ष के दौरान मनोज ने ₹ 40,000 तथा नितिन ने ₹ 20,000 का आहरण किया । बाद में, ध्यान दिया गया कि साझेदारों को 10% वार्षिक दर से पूँजी पर ब्याज नहीं दिया गया था । मनोज के आहरण पर ₹ 3,000 तथा नितिन के आहरण पर ₹ 2,000 का ब्याज भी प्रभारित नहीं किया गया था । आवश्यक समायोजन रोज़नामचा प्रविष्टि कीजिए। अपने कार्य को स्पष्टता से दर्शाइए ।
sub_questions.text_english: (b) Manoj and Nitin were partners in a firm sharing profits and losses in the ratio of 2:1. On 31st March, 2023, the balances in their capital accounts after making adjustments for profits and drawings were ₹ 90,000 and ₹ 80,000 respectively. The net profit for the year ended 31st March, 2023 amounted to ₹ 30,000. During the year Manoj withdrew ₹ 40,000 and Nitin withdrew ₹ 20,000. Subsequently, it was noticed that Interest on Capital @ 10% p.a. was not provided to the partners. Also Interest on Drawings to Manoj ₹ 3,000 and to Nitin ₹ 2,000 was not charged. Pass necessary adjusting journal entry. Show your workings clearly.

key_points: Calculation of Opening Capital: Closing Capital + Drawings - Share of Profit (30,000 in 2:1 ratio).
Interest on Capital @ 10%: Manoj = 11,000; Nitin = 9,000. Total = 20,000.
Correct Divisible Profit = Original Profit (30,000) - IOC (20,000) + IOD (5,000) = 15,000 (Manoj 10,000; Nitin 5,000).
Already credited: Manoj = 20,000; Nitin = 10,000.
Net effect: Manoj is debited by 2,000, Nitin is credited by 2,000.
Entry: Manoj's Capital A/c Dr 2,000 To Nitin's Capital A/c 2,000.

sub_questions.solution: First, the opening capitals must be calculated to compute interest accurately. Adding back drawings and subtracting the wrongly distributed ₹30,000 profit (distributed in 2:1) yields opening capitals of ₹1,10,000 for Manoj and ₹90,000 for Nitin. The rightful 10% Interest on Capital is ₹11,000 for Manoj and ₹9,000 for Nitin, totaling ₹20,000. Including Interest on Drawings (₹5,000), the correctly adjusted divisible profit is ₹15,000 (₹30,000 - ₹20,000 + ₹5,000), giving Manoj ₹10,000 and Nitin ₹5,000. Therefore, the absolute correct credits they should have received for the year are ₹18,000 for Manoj (₹11k IOC - ₹3k IOD + ₹10k profit) and ₹12,000 for Nitin (₹9k IOC - ₹2k IOD + ₹5k profit). Because they were wrongly credited ₹20,000 and ₹10,000 respectively, Manoj was over-credited by ₹2,000 and Nitin was under-credited by ₹2,000. The precise adjusting entry debits Manoj's Capital Account for ₹2,000 and credits Nitin's Capital Account for ₹2,000.

Shivalik Limited was registered with an authorized capital of ₹ 10,00,000 divided into equity shares of ₹ 10 each. It offered 50,000 equity shares to the public. The amount was payable as follows:
On Application ₹ 2 per share
On Allotment ₹ 6 per share
On First and Final call Balance
The issue was fully subscribed. All the amounts were duly received except the allotment and first and final call money on 4,000 equity shares. These equity shares were forfeited.
Present the Share Capital in the Balance Sheet of the company as per Schedule III, Part I of the Companies Act, 2013. Also prepare 'Notes to Accounts' for the same.

key_points: Authorized Capital: 1,00,000 Equity shares of ₹10 each = ₹10,00,000.
Issued Capital: 50,000 Equity shares of ₹10 each = ₹5,00,000.
Subscribed Capital: 46,000 Equity shares of ₹10 each fully paid up = ₹4,60,000.
Add: Share Forfeiture Account (4,000 shares × ₹2 received on application) = ₹8,000.
Total Share Capital to be shown in the Balance Sheet = ₹4,68,000.

questions.solution: In the Notes to Accounts under 'Share Capital', the Authorized Capital is presented first as 1,00,000 Equity Shares of ₹10 each, amounting to ₹10,00,000. This is followed by the Issued Capital of 50,000 Equity Shares of ₹10 each, equal to ₹5,00,000. For Subscribed Capital, since 4,000 shares were completely forfeited and not reissued, the 'Subscribed and Fully Paid up' category will show only 46,000 Equity Shares of ₹10 each, totaling ₹4,60,000. Additionally, the amount retained by the company on the 4,000 forfeited shares (the ₹2 application money paid) must be added. This ₹8,000 is placed under 'Add: Share Forfeiture Account'. Therefore, the final total of Share Capital to be strictly extracted to the main Balance Sheet under the 'Equity and Liabilities' segment is accurately recorded as ₹4,68,000.
questions.solution_hindi: खातों के नोट्स (Notes to Accounts) में 'अंश पूंजी' के अंतर्गत, अधिकृत पूंजी को पहले ₹10 प्रत्येक के 1,00,000 समता अंशों के रूप में प्रस्तुत किया जाता है, जो ₹10,00,000 है। इसके बाद ₹10 प्रत्येक के 50,000 समता अंशों की निर्गमित पूंजी, जो ₹5,00,000 के बराबर है। अभिदत्त पूंजी के लिए, चूंकि 4,000 अंशों को पूरी तरह से हरण कर लिया गया था और पुनः निर्गमित नहीं किया गया था, इसलिए 'अभिदत्त और पूर्ण प्रदत्त' श्रेणी में केवल 46,000 समता अंश ₹10 प्रत्येक के दिखाए जाएंगे, जो कुल ₹4,60,000 है। इसके अतिरिक्त, कंपनी द्वारा 4,000 हरण किए गए अंशों पर रखी गई राशि (भुगतान की गई ₹2 आवेदन राशि) को जोड़ा जाना चाहिए। इस ₹8,000 को 'जोड़ें: अंश हरण खाता' के तहत रखा जाता है। इसलिए, 'समता और देयताएं' खंड के तहत मुख्य स्थिति विवरण में सटीक रूप से दर्शाए जाने वाले अंश पूंजी का अंतिम योग ₹4,68,000 दर्ज किया जाता है।

questions.text_english:
Archana, Vandana and Arti were partners in a firm sharing profits and losses in the ratio of 5:3:2. Their Balance Sheet on 31st March, 2023 was as follows:

| Liabilities | Amount (₹) | Assets | Amount (₹) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Capitals: Archana | 80,000 | Investments | 80,000 |
| Vandana | 70,000 | Plant | 1,00,000 |
| Arti | 60,000 | Stock | 40,000 |
| General Reserve | 30,000 | Debtors | 50,000 |
| Creditors | 60,000 | Cash at Bank | 30,000 |
| Total | 3,00,000 | Total | 3,00,000 |

The firm was dissolved on the above date.
(i) Assets were realised as follows:
Debtors ₹ 40,000
Stock ₹ 50,000
Plant ₹ 60,000
(ii) 25% of the Investments were taken over by Vandana at ₹ 18,000. Remaining Investments were taken over by Archana at 10% less than its book value.
(iii) Expenses of realisation ₹ 20,000 were paid by Arti.
Prepare Realisation Account.

key_points: Transfer of Assets to debit side: Investments (80,000), Plant (1,00,000), Stock (40,000), Debtors (50,000) = Total 2,70,000.
Transfer of Liabilities to credit side: Creditors (60,000).
Assets realized credited to Bank: Debtors (40k) + Stock (50k) + Plant (60k) = 1,50,000.
Investments taken over: Vandana's Cap A/c (18,000), Archana's Cap A/c (60,000 - 10% = 54,000).
Payment of Liabilities (implied full): Bank A/c Dr 60,000.
Expenses paid by Arti: Arti's Cap A/c Dr 20,000 on the debit side.
Realisation Loss calculation: Total Debit (3,50,000) - Total Credit (2,82,000) = 68,000.
Distribution of Loss in 5:3:2: Archana (34,000), Vandana (20,400), Arti (13,600).

questions.solution: The Realisation Account systematically closes all asset and liability ledgers to calculate dissolution profit or loss. First, debit the account to transfer non-cash assets at book value: Investments (₹80,000), Plant (₹1,00,000), Stock (₹40,000), and Debtors (₹50,000), totaling ₹2,70,000. Second, credit the account to transfer Creditors (₹60,000). Assets realized in cash (Debtors, Stock, Plant) total ₹1,50,000, credited to the Realisation Account via Bank. For Investments, Vandana takes 25% (₹20,000 book value) for ₹18,000, and Archana takes the remaining 75% (₹60,000 book value) at a 10% discount for ₹54,000; both are credited to their respective Capital Accounts. Liabilities are paid off completely, debiting Realisation for ₹60,000 (via Bank). Realisation expenses of ₹20,000 paid by Arti are debited and credited to her Capital Account. The total debit side is ₹3,50,000 and the credit side is ₹2,82,000, resulting in a Realisation Loss of ₹68,000. This loss is distributed in the 5:3:2 ratio: Archana (₹34,000), Vandana (₹20,400), and Arti (₹13,600).
questions.solution_hindi: वसूली खाता (Realisation Account) सभी परिसंपत्तियों को बंद करने और देनदारियों के निपटान को संभालता है। डेबिट पक्ष पर, सभी गैर-नकद संपत्तियों को पुस्तक मूल्य पर स्थानांतरित किया जाता है: निवेश (₹80,000), संयंत्र (₹1,00,000), स्टॉक (₹40,000), और देनदार (₹50,000), कुल ₹2,70,000। लेनदारों को क्रेडिट पक्ष में ₹60,000 पर स्थानांतरित किया जाता है। परिसंपत्तियों (देनदार, स्टॉक, संयंत्र) से प्राप्त नकद ₹1,50,000 है, जिसे बैंक खाते के माध्यम से क्रेडिट किया जाता है। निवेश के लिए, 25% (₹20,000 पुस्तक मूल्य) वंदना द्वारा ₹18,000 में लिया जाता है। शेष 75% (₹60,000 पुस्तक मूल्य) अर्चना द्वारा 10% छूट पर लिया जाता है, जो ₹54,000 है; दोनों को उनके पूंजी खातों में क्रेडिट किया जाता है। लेनदारों का डेबिट पक्ष पर ₹60,000 का पूर्ण भुगतान किया जाता है, और वसूली व्यय के लिए आरती को ₹20,000 का क्रेडिट दिया जाता है। डेबिट पक्ष (₹3,50,000) को जोड़ने और क्रेडिट पक्ष (₹2,82,000) को घटाने पर ₹68,000 की शुद्ध वसूली हानि का पता चलता है। यह हानि अर्चना (₹34,000), वंदना (₹20,400), और आरती (₹13,600) के बीच 5:3:2 के अनुपात में वितरित की जाती है।

questions.text_english:
Jatin, Kartik and Lakhan were partners in a firm sharing profits and losses in the ratio of 7:5: 3. Their Balance Sheet as at 31st March, 2023, was as follows:

| Liabilities | Amount ₹ | Assets | Amount ₹ |
|---|---|---|---|
| Bills Payable | 80,000 | Bank | 40,000 |
| General Reserve | 60,000 | Stock | 80,000 |
| Capitals: Jatin | 1,00,000 | Debtors | 1,00,000 |
| Kartik | 60,000 | Fixed Assets | 1,20,000 |
| Lakhan | 40,000 | | |
| Total | 3,40,000 | Total | 3,40,000 |

Kartik died on 30th September, 2023. According to the partnership deed, Kartik's legal representatives were entitled to the following:
(i) Balance in his Capital Account.
(ii) Interest on capital @ 10% p.a.
(iii) His share of goodwill. Goodwill of the firm was valued on the basis of twice the average of the preceding four years profits.
(iv) His share in profits up to the date of death on the basis of total profits for the preceding two years.
Profits for the previous four years were :
2019-20 ₹ 1,41,000
2020-21 ₹ (30,000)
2021-22 ₹ 60,000
2022-23 ₹ 69,000
Prepare Kartik's Capital Account to be rendered to his legal representatives.

key_points: Credit balance brought down: ₹60,000.
Share of General Reserve: 5/15th of 60,000 = ₹20,000.
Interest on Capital: 60,000 × 10% × (6/12) months = ₹3,000.
Calculation of Goodwill: 4-yr Average Profit = (1,41,000 - 30,000 + 60,000 + 69,000)/4 = 60,000. Firm Goodwill = 60,000 × 2 = 1,20,000. Kartik's share = 1,20,000 × 5/15 = ₹40,000.
Share of Profit up to death: Total of preceding two years = 60,000 + 69,000 = 1,29,000. Assumed yearly profit = 1,29,000. Kartik's share = 1,29,000 × (6/12) months × (5/15) share = ₹21,500.
Total credit side of Kartik's Capital A/c = 60,000 + 20,000 + 3,000 + 40,000 + 21,500 = ₹1,44,500.
Transfer balance of ₹1,44,500 to Kartik's Executors Account.

questions.solution: Kartik's Capital Account determines the exact amount due to his executors upon his death. Start on the credit side with his opening capital balance of ₹60,000. His 5/15th share of the ₹60,000 General Reserve equals ₹20,000. Kartik died exactly six months into the financial year (30th September), entitling him to 6 months' Interest on Capital: ₹60,000 × 10% × 6/12 = ₹3,000. To ascertain his share of goodwill, compute the four-year average profit: (1,41,000 - 30,000 + 60,000 + 69,000) / 4 = ₹60,000. The firm's goodwill is twice this average, or ₹1,20,000. Kartik’s 5/15th share amounts to ₹40,000, compensated by Jatin and Lakhan. Finally, his share of profit up to his death is based strictly on the total profits of the preceding two years, which is ₹60,000 + ₹69,000 = ₹1,29,000. Assuming this as the base yearly profit, his share for 6 months is ₹1,29,000 × 6/12 × 5/15 = ₹21,500, recorded via P&L Suspense Account. Summing all credits yields a grand total of ₹1,44,500, which is fully transferred to Kartik's Executors Account on the debit side.
questions.solution_hindi: कार्तिक का पूंजी खाता उसकी मृत्यु पर उसके निष्पादकों को देय सटीक राशि निर्धारित करता है। क्रेडिट पक्ष पर उसके ₹60,000 के शुरुआती पूंजी शेष के साथ शुरू करें। ₹60,000 के सामान्य संचय का उसका 5/15 वां हिस्सा ₹20,000 के बराबर है। कार्तिक की मृत्यु वित्तीय वर्ष (30 सितंबर) में ठीक छह महीने बाद हुई थी, जिससे वह 6 महीने की पूंजी पर ब्याज का हकदार था: ₹60,000 × 10% × 6/12 = ₹3,000। ख्याति का उसका हिस्सा सुनिश्चित करने के लिए, चार साल के औसत लाभ की गणना करें: (1,41,000 - 30,000 + 60,000 + 69,000) / 4 = ₹60,000। फर्म की ख्याति इस औसत से दोगुनी या ₹1,20,000 है। कार्तिक का 5/15 वां हिस्सा ₹40,000 है, जिसकी भरपाई जतिन और लखन ने की है। अंत में, उसकी मृत्यु तक के लाभ का उसका हिस्सा पूरी तरह से पिछले दो वर्षों के कुल लाभ पर आधारित है, जो ₹60,000 + ₹69,000 = ₹1,29,000 है। इसे आधार वार्षिक लाभ मानते हुए, 6 महीने के लिए उसका हिस्सा ₹1,29,000 × 6/12 × 5/15 = ₹21,500 है, जिसे P&L सस्पेंस खाते के माध्यम से दर्ज किया गया है। सभी क्रेडिट को जोड़ने पर ₹1,44,500 का कुल योग प्राप्त होता है, जिसे डेबिट पक्ष पर पूरी तरह से कार्तिक के निष्पादक (Executors) खाते में स्थानांतरित कर दिया जाता है।

On 1st April, 2022, Zoltas Ltd. issued 20,000 7% Debentures of ₹ 100 each at a discount of 5%, redeemable at par after five years. The company had a balance of ₹ 70,000 in Securities Premium Account.
(a) Pass necessary journal entries for issue of debentures and for writing off 'Discount on Issue of Debentures' utilising Securities Premium Account at the end of first year itself.
(b) Prepare 'Discount on Issue of Debentures Account' for the year ended 31st March, 2023.

key_points: (a) Issue entry 1: Bank A/c Dr 19,00,000 To Debenture App & Allotment A/c 19,00,000.
(a) Issue entry 2: Debenture App & Allotment A/c Dr 19,00,000, Discount on Issue of Debentures A/c Dr 1,00,000 To 7% Debentures A/c 20,00,000.
(a) Write-off entry: Securities Premium Reserve A/c Dr 70,000, Statement of Profit and Loss Dr 30,000 To Discount on Issue of Debentures A/c 1,00,000.

(b) Discount on Issue of Debentures Account: Debit side: 'To 7% Debentures A/c' 1,00,000. Credit side: 'By Securities Premium Reserve A/c' 70,000, 'By Statement of Profit and Loss' 30,000. Account is closed.

questions.solution: Zoltas Ltd. issued 20,000 7% debentures of ₹100 each at a 5% discount (₹95 issue price), and they are strictly redeemable at par. The total money received is ₹19,00,000, recorded by debiting Bank and crediting Debenture Application & Allotment. The discount allowed is ₹5 per debenture, totaling ₹1,00,000. The allotment entry systematically debits Debenture App & Allotment for ₹19,00,000 and 'Discount on Issue of Debentures' for ₹1,00,000, while crediting 7% Debentures for the full face value of ₹20,00,000. To write off this ₹1,00,000 discount, the company first completely utilizes the existing ₹70,000 balance in the Securities Premium Reserve. The remaining ₹30,000 must be rigorously charged to the Statement of Profit and Loss. The write-off entry debits SPR for ₹70,000 and Statement of P&L for ₹30,000, while crediting Discount on Issue of Debentures for ₹1,00,000. In the ledger, the 'Discount on Issue of Debentures Account' shows a single debit of ₹1,00,000 (To 7% Debentures) and two credits (By SPR ₹70,000; By Statement of P&L ₹30,000), perfectly balancing the account.
questions.solution_hindi: ज़ोलटास लिमिटेड ने ₹100 प्रत्येक के 20,000 7% ऋणपत्र 5% बट्टे (₹95 निर्गम मूल्य) पर जारी किए, और वे सममूल्य पर प्रतिदेय हैं। प्राप्त कुल धनराशि ₹19,00,000 है, जिसे बैंक को डेबिट करके और डिबेंचर एप्लीकेशन और अलॉटमेंट को क्रेडिट करके दर्ज किया जाता है। अनुमत बट्टा ₹5 प्रति डिबेंचर है, जो कुल ₹1,00,000 है। आवंटन प्रविष्टि डिबेंचर एप्लिकेशन और अलॉटमेंट को ₹19,00,000 और 'ऋणपत्रों के निर्गमन पर बट्टा' को ₹1,00,000 के लिए डेबिट करती है, जबकि 7% डिबेंचर को ₹20,00,000 के पूर्ण अंकित मूल्य के लिए क्रेडिट करती है। इस ₹1,00,000 की छूट को अपलिखित करने के लिए, कंपनी पहले प्रतिभूति प्रीमियम खाते में मौजूद ₹70,000 के शेष का पूरी तरह से उपयोग करती है। शेष ₹30,000 को लाभ-हानि विवरण (Statement of Profit and Loss) से चार्ज किया जाना चाहिए। राइट-ऑफ प्रविष्टि SPR को ₹70,000 और लाभ-हानि विवरण को ₹30,000 से डेबिट करती है, जबकि ऋणपत्रों के निर्गमन पर बट्टा को ₹1,00,000 से क्रेडिट करती है। बहीखाते में, 'ऋणपत्रों के निर्गमन पर बट्टा खाता' ₹1,00,000 का एकल डेबिट (टू 7% डिबेंचर) और दो क्रेडिट (बाय SPR ₹70,000; बाय लाभ-हानि विवरण ₹30,000) दर्शाता है, जो खाते को पूरी तरह संतुलित करता है।

(a) Qumtan Ltd. invited applications for issuing 1,00,000 equity shares of ₹ 10 each at a premium of 6 per share. The amount was payable as follows:
On Application and Allotment ₹ 8 per share (including premium ₹ 3)
On First and Final call Balance (including premium)
Applications for 1,60,000 shares were received. Applications for 10,000 shares were rejected and pro-rata allotment was made to the remaining applicants. Excess money received on application and allotment was returned. Dheeraj, who was allotted 200 shares, failed to pay the first and final call money. His shares were forfeited. All the forfeited shares were reissued at ₹ 5 per share fully paid up. Pass necessary journal entries in the books of Qumtan Ltd.

key_points: Issue price is 16. App & Allot is 8 (Cap 5, Prem 3). Call is 8 (Cap 5, Prem 3).
1,60,000 applied. 10,000 rejected (80,000 refunded). Remaining 1,50,000 applied allotted 1,00,000 (ratio 3:2).

Dheeraj allotted 200 shares. Since excess money was fully returned (as it says 'excess money received on application and allotment was returned'), no excess money was adjusted to calls for any shareholder.
Call arrears for Dheeraj: 200 * 8 = 1,600.
Forfeiture Entry: Share Capital Dr (200*10 = 2,000), SPR Dr (200*3 = 600) To Share Forfeiture A/c (200*5 = 1,000) To Calls in Arrears (1,600).
Reissue Entry: Bank A/c Dr (200*5 = 1,000), Share Forfeiture A/c Dr 1,000 To Share Capital A/c 2,000.
Transfer to Capital Reserve = Nil (since all 1,000 in forfeiture account was used as discount).

sub_questions.solution: The issue price is ₹16 (₹10 capital + ₹6 premium), structured as ₹8 on App & Allotment (₹5 Cap, ₹3 Prem) and ₹8 on Call (₹5 Cap, ₹3 Prem). Applications for 1,60,000 shares yielded ₹12,80,000. 10,000 applications were cleanly rejected (₹80,000 refunded). Pro-rata was made for 1,50,000 applicants for 1,00,000 shares. The explicit instruction states excess application/allotment money was fully returned. Thus, the surplus ₹4,00,000 from pro-rata applicants was completely refunded, bringing total refunds to ₹4,80,000. Dheeraj, holding 200 shares, failed the ₹8 call. Since all excess was refunded, he had no advance. His shares were forfeited: Share Capital is debited for ₹2,000 (200×10) and SPR for ₹600 (unpaid premium). Credit Share Forfeiture for ₹1,000 (capital paid) and Calls in Arrears for ₹1,600. Reissuing all 200 shares at ₹5 fully paid allows a ₹5 discount per share, consuming the entire ₹1,000 in the Forfeiture account, leaving nil balance to transfer to Capital Reserve.

(b) Printkit Limited invited applications for issue of 80,000 equity shares of ₹ 10 each. The amount was payable as follows:
On Application - ₹ 3 per share
On Allotment - ₹ 2 per share
On First and Final call Balance
Applications for 1,50,000 shares were received. Applications for 10,000 shares were rejected and pro-rata allotment was made to the remaining applicants on the following basis:
Category A Applicants for 80,000 shares were allotted 40,000 shares.
Category B Applicants for 60,000 shares were allotted 40,000 shares.
Excess money received on application was adjusted towards amount due on allotment and first and final call. All the amounts due on allotment and first and final call were duly received.
Pass necessary journal entries in the books of Printkit Limited.

key_points: Total application money received: 1,50,000 × 3 = 4,50,000.
Capital requirement: 80,000 × 3 = 2,40,000. Refund for rejected: 10,000 × 3 = 30,000.
Category A excess: (80k - 40k) × 3 = 1,20,000. Allotment due is 40k × 2 = 80,000. Excess 40,000 goes to Calls in Advance.
Category B excess: (60k - 40k) × 3 = 60,000. Allotment due is 40k × 2 = 80,000. All 60,000 adjusted on allotment.
Total adjusted to Allotment = 80,000 + 60,000 = 1,40,000. Total adjusted to Calls in Advance = 40,000.
First & Final Call due = 80,000 × 5 = 4,00,000. Received = 4,00,000 - 40,000 (advance) = 3,60,000.

sub_questions.solution: Printkit Limited received ₹4,50,000 on application for 1,50,000 shares (at ₹3 each). 10,000 shares were rejected, causing a flat ₹30,000 refund. The required application capital for 80,000 shares is ₹2,40,000. Pro-rata was divided into two categories. Category A (80k applied, 40k allotted) provided ₹2,40,000 but only ₹1,20,000 was needed. The ₹1,20,000 excess covers the entire ₹80,000 allotment due, with the remaining ₹40,000 pushed to Calls in Advance. Category B (60k applied, 40k allotted) provided ₹1,80,000 but needed ₹1,20,000. The ₹60,000 excess is completely consumed by their ₹80,000 allotment due. Total adjustments: ₹1,40,000 to Allotment and ₹40,000 to Calls in Advance. The net allotment money received is ₹1,60,000 (total due) minus ₹1,40,000 (adjusted) = ₹20,000. The final call due is ₹4,00,000 (80k × ₹5). Deducting the ₹40,000 from Calls in Advance, the exact bank receipt is ₹3,60,000. Journal entries sequentially reflect these calculated bank receipts and capital transfers.

(a) Shubhi and Revanshi were partners in a firm sharing profits and losses in the ratio of 3:2. Their Balance Sheet as at 31st March, 2023 was as follows:

| Liabilities | Amount ₹ | Assets | Amount ₹ |
|---|---|---|---|
| Capitals: Shubhi | 60,000 | Fixed Assets | 90,000 |
| Revanshi | 32,000 | Stock | 38,000 |
| | 92,000 | Debtors | 30,000 |
| General Reserve | 30,000 | Cash | 52,000 |
| Bank Loan | 18,000 | | |
| Creditors | 70,000 | | |
| Total | 2,10,000 | Total | 2,10,000 |

On 1st April, 2023 they admitted Pari into the partnership on the following terms:
(i) Pari will bring ₹50,000 as her capital and ₹50,000 for her share of premium for goodwill for 1/4th share in the profits of the firm.
(ii) Fixed assets were depreciated @ 30%.
(iii) Stock was valued at ₹ 45,000.
(iv) Bank loan was paid off.
(v) After all adjustments capitals of Shubhi and Revanshi were to be adjusted taking Pari's capital as the base. Actual cash was to be paid off or brought in by the old partners as the case may be.
Prepare Revaluation Account and Partners' Capital Accounts.

key_points: Revaluation Account: Debit Fixed Assets by 27,000 (30% of 90k). Credit Stock by 7,000 (45k - 38k). Net Revaluation Loss = 20,000. Distributed 3:2 (Shubhi 12,000; Revanshi 8,000).
Goodwill Distribution: Premium 50,000 credited in sacrificing ratio 3:2 (Shubhi 30,000; Revanshi 20,000).
General Reserve: 30,000 distributed in old ratio 3:2 (Shubhi 18,000; Revanshi 12,000).
Adjusted Old Capitals (before target): Shubhi = 60k + 30k + 18k - 12k = 96,000. Revanshi = 32k + 20k + 12k - 8k = 56,000.
Target Capital Calculation: Pari's cap is 50,000 for 1/4. Total firm cap = 2,00,000. New ratio = (3/4)*3/5 : (3/4)*2/5 : 1/4 = 9:6:5. So new capitals: Shubhi = 90,000, Revanshi = 60,000.
Cash adjustment: Shubhi withdraws 6,000. Revanshi brings in 4,000.

sub_questions.solution: The Revaluation Account reveals a depreciation of Fixed Assets by ₹27,000 (30% of 90k) and an appreciation of Stock by ₹7,000. The net revaluation loss is ₹20,000, shared 3:2, debiting Shubhi ₹12,000 and Revanshi ₹8,000. In the Capital Accounts, opening balances are ₹60,000 and ₹32,000. The General Reserve of ₹30,000 is credited in 3:2 as ₹18,000 and ₹12,000. Pari brings ₹50,000 capital and ₹50,000 goodwill premium. The premium is credited to old partners in their sacrificing ratio (3:2) as ₹30,000 and ₹20,000. Adjusted capitals before final adjustment are ₹96,000 for Shubhi and ₹56,000 for Revanshi. With Pari's capital of ₹50,000 for 1/4th share, total firm capital is ₹2,00,000. The new ratio is 9:6:5, meaning the target capitals must be ₹90,000 for Shubhi and ₹60,000 for Revanshi. Comparing adjusted to target capitals, Shubhi has a surplus of ₹6,000 which she withdraws, and Revanshi has a deficit of ₹4,000 which she must bring in cash.

questions.text_english: Analysis of Financial Statements is useful and significant to different users. Which of the following users is particularly interested in the firm's ability to meet their claims over a very short period of time?
questions.solution: Trade payables, encompassing suppliers and short-term creditors, provide goods and services on immediate credit terms. questions.solution: Solvency ratios are the precise financial metrics deployed to evaluate an organization's capability to safely service and sustain its debt obligations over the long run. questions.solution_hindi: ऋण-शोधन क्षमता (Solvency) अनुपात वे सटीक वित्तीय मीट्रिक हैं जिन्हें लंबे समय तक अपने ऋण दायित्वों को सुरक्षित रूप से पूरा करने और बनाए रखने के लिए किसी संगठन की क्षमता का मूल्यांकन करने के लिए तैनात किया जाता है। ऋण और इक्विटी के बीच संबंधों का विश्लेषण करके, ये अनुपात व्यवसाय की दीर्घकालिक वित्तीय स्थिरता और संरचनात्मक सहनशक्ति को प्रकट करते हैं।

questions.text_english: The Quick Ratio of a company is 1: 2. Which of the following transactions will result in an increase in this ratio?
questions.solution: The Quick Ratio evaluates highly liquid quick assets against current liabilities. Selling goods on credit successfully converts inventory (which is explicitly excluded from quick assets) into debtors (which are classified as quick assets). This functional transaction directly increases the numerator (quick assets) without altering the denominator (current liabilities), thereby resulting in a definitive mathematical increase in the quick ratio.
questions.solution_hindi: त्वरित (Quick) अनुपात वर्तमान देनदारियों के विरुद्ध अत्यधिक तरल त्वरित संपत्तियों का मूल्यांकन करता है। माल का उधार विक्रय इन्वेंट्री (जिसे त्वरित संपत्तियों से स्पष्ट रूप से बाहर रखा गया है) को देनदारों (जिन्हें त्वरित संपत्ति के रूप में वर्गीकृत किया गया है) में सफलतापूर्वक परिवर्तित करता है। यह कार्यात्मक लेनदेन सीधे अंश (त्वरित संपत्ति) को बढ़ाता है, बिना हर (वर्तमान देनदारियों) को बदले, जिससे त्वरित अनुपात में निश्चित गणितीय वृद्धि होती है।

options.B: एक गैर-वित्तीय कम्पनी द्वारा ब्याज की प्राप्ति
options.C: एक गैर-वित्तीय कम्पनी द्वारा लाभांश की प्राप्ति

options_english.C: Dividend received by a non-finance company

questions.solution: Cash flows from operating activities represent the primary revenue-generating mechanisms of an enterprise. Receiving amounts from debtors directly corresponds to the realization of cash from standard credit sales, serving as a core operational inflow. Payment to creditors is an outflow, while interest or dividend receipts by non-finance companies are strictly classified as investing cash flows.
questions.solution_hindi: परिचालन गतिविधियों से नकदी प्रवाह एक उद्यम के प्राथमिक राजस्व-उत्पादक तंत्र का प्रतिनिधित्व करता है। देनदारों से प्राप्त धनराशि सीधे मानक उधार बिक्री से नकदी की प्राप्ति से मेल खाती है, जो एक मुख्य परिचालन अंतर्वाह के रूप में कार्य करती है। लेनदारों को भुगतान एक बहिर्वाह है, जबकि गैर-वित्त कंपनियों द्वारा ब्याज या लाभांश प्राप्तियों को सख्ती से निवेश नकदी प्रवाह के रूप में वर्गीकृत किया जाता है।

questions.text_english:
From the given information, calculate :
(a) Trade Receivables Turnover Ratio
(b) Current Ratio

| Particulars | Amount (₹) |
|---|---|
| Credit Revenue from Operations | 80,00,000 |
| Debtors | 25,00,000 |
| Bills Receivables | 15,00,000 |
| Total Assets | 50,00,000 |
| 10% Debentures | 12,00,000 |
| Creditors | 13,00,000 |
| Bills Payable | 7,00,000 |

key_points: (a) Trade Receivables = Debtors + Bills Receivables = 25,00,000 + 15,00,000 = 40,00,000.
(a) Trade Receivables Turnover Ratio = Credit Revenue from Operations / Average Trade Receivables = 80,00,000 / 40,00,000 = 2 Times.
(b) Current Assets (assuming Trade Receivables are the only current assets) = 40,00,000.
(b) Current Liabilities = Creditors + Bills Payable = 13,00,000 + 7,00,000 = 20,00,000.
(b) Current Ratio = Current Assets / Current Liabilities = 40,00,000 / 20,00,000 = 2 : 1.

questions.solution: To calculate the Trade Receivables Turnover Ratio, first determine the Total Trade Receivables by summing Debtors (₹25,00,000) and Bills Receivables (₹15,00,000), which yields ₹40,00,000. Applying the formula, divide Credit Revenue from Operations (₹80,00,000) by the Trade Receivables (₹40,00,000) to get a clear result of 2 Times. For the Current Ratio, we must deduce Current Assets and Current Liabilities. Assuming the provided Trade Receivables represent the entirely of the Current Assets, we use ₹40,00,000. Current Liabilities are determined by summing Creditors (₹13,00,000) and Bills Payable (₹7,00,000), giving ₹20,00,000. Dividing Current Assets by Current Liabilities (₹40L / ₹20L) definitively calculates to a Current Ratio of 2:1.
questions.solution_hindi: व्यापारिक प्राप्य आवर्त (Trade Receivables Turnover) अनुपात की गणना करने के लिए, पहले देनदारों (₹25,00,000) और प्राप्य विपत्र (₹15,00,000) को जोड़कर कुल व्यापारिक प्राप्य निर्धारित करें, जो ₹40,00,000 आता है। सूत्र लागू करते हुए, प्रचालन से उधार आगम (₹80,00,00,000) को व्यापारिक प्राप्य (₹40,00,000) से विभाजित करें ताकि 2 गुना (2 Times) का स्पष्ट परिणाम मिल सके। चालू (Current) अनुपात के लिए, हमें चालू संपत्तियों और चालू देनदारियों का अनुमान लगाना होगा। यह मानते हुए कि प्रदान किए गए व्यापारिक प्राप्य पूरी तरह से चालू संपत्तियों का प्रतिनिधित्व करते हैं, हम ₹40,00,000 का उपयोग करते हैं। चालू देनदारियों को लेनदारों (₹13,00,000) और देय विपत्र (₹7,00,000) को जोड़कर निर्धारित किया जाता है, जो ₹20,00,000 देता है। चालू संपत्तियों को चालू देनदारियों से विभाजित करने पर (₹40L / ₹20L) निश्चित रूप से 2:1 के चालू अनुपात की गणना होती है।

From the following information, calculate 'Cash Flows From Operating Activities':

| Particulars | Amount (₹) |
|---|---|
| Surplus i.e. Balance in Statement of Profit and Loss | 6,28,000 |
| Provision for Tax | 1,50,000 |
| Proposed Dividend for the previous year | 72,000 |
| Depreciation | 1,40,000 |
| Loss on Sale of Machinery | 30,000 |
| Gain on Sale of Investments | 20,000 |
| Dividend Received on Investments | 6,000 |
| Increase in Current Liabilities | 1,61,000 |
| Increase in Current Assets (other than cash and cash equivalents) | 6,00,000 |
| Decrease in Current Liabilities | 64,000 |

key_points: Net Profit Before Tax & Extraordinary Items = Surplus (6,28,000) + Provision for Tax (1,50,000) + Proposed Div (72,000) = 8,50,000.
Add non-cash/non-operating charges: Depreciation (1,40,000) + Loss on sale (30,000) = 1,70,000.
Less non-operating incomes: Gain on sale (20,000) + Dividend received (6,000) = 26,000.
Operating Profit before Working Capital changes = 8,50,000 + 1,70,000 - 26,000 = 9,94,000.
Working Capital Adjustments: Add Increase in CL (1,61,000), Less Decrease in CL (64,000), Less Increase in CA (6,00,000).
Cash generated from operations = 9,94,000 + 1,61,000 - 6,64,000 = 4,91,000.
Less Income Tax Paid (1,18,000).
Net Cash Flow from Operating Activities = 3,73,000.

questions.solution: Commence by calculating the Net Profit before Tax and Extraordinary Items. Using the given Surplus of ₹6,28,000, strictly add back the current Provision for Tax (₹1,50,000) and the previous year's Proposed Dividend (₹72,000), creating a profit base of ₹8,50,000. To deduce Operating Profit before working capital changes, non-cash/non-operating debits like Depreciation (₹1,40,000) and Loss on Sale (₹30,000) are added back, whilst non-operating credits like Gain on Sale (₹20,000) and Dividend Received (₹6,000) are deducted, yielding ₹9,94,000. Working capital adjustments involve adding the Increase in Current Liabilities (₹1,61,000) and deducting both the Increase in Current Assets (₹6,00,000) and the Decrease in Current Liabilities (₹64,000). The resulting Cash Generated from Operations is ₹4,91,000. Finally, deducting the Income Tax Paid (₹1,18,000) solidifies the Net Cash Flow from Operating Activities at exactly ₹3,73,000.

questions.solution: The PMT function in Excel relies on specific parameters configured as: PMT(rate, nper, pv, [fv], [type]). This calculation strictly assumes that both the payment amount and the applied interest rate remain entirely constant throughout the entire lifespan of the loan.

questions.text: 'लुकअप' (Lookup) कार्य के दो वाक्य-विन्यास रूपों को समझाइए ।
questions.text_english: Explain the two syntax forms of 'Lookup' function.

key_points: Vector form: Searches a one-row or one-column range (the lookup vector) for a value and returns a value from the same position in a second one-row or one-column range (the result vector).
Syntax: LOOKUP(lookup_value, lookup_vector, [result_vector]).
Array form: Searches the first row or column of a strict array for the specified value and returns a value from the same position in the last row or column of the array.
Syntax: LOOKUP(lookup_value, array).

questions.solution: The LOOKUP function in spreadsheet applications is rigorously designed to fetch specific data, utilizing two distinct syntax formats: the Vector form and the Array form. The Vector form is deployed when a user needs to search a specific single row or column (known as the lookup_vector) to locate a desired value. Once identified, it extracts the corresponding output from an identical position in a completely separate single row or column (the result_vector). Its syntax is: =LOOKUP(lookup_value, lookup_vector, [result_vector]). Conversely, the Array form blindly searches the very first row or column of a defined block of cells (the array) for the target value. Upon finding it, it automatically retrieves the corresponding value resting in the exact same position in the absolute last row or column of that identical array. Its simplified syntax is: =LOOKUP(lookup_value, array).
questions.solution_hindi: स्प्रेडशीट अनुप्रयोगों में LOOKUP फ़ंक्शन को विशिष्ट डेटा प्राप्त करने के लिए कठोरता से डिज़ाइन किया गया है, जिसमें दो अलग-अलग सिंटैक्स (वाक्य-विन्यास) प्रारूपों का उपयोग किया जाता है: वेक्टर रूप और सरणी (Array) रूप। वेक्टर रूप (Vector form) का उपयोग तब किया जाता है जब उपयोगकर्ता को वांछित मूल्य का पता लगाने के लिए एक विशिष्ट एकल पंक्ति या स्तंभ (जिसे lookup_vector के रूप में जाना जाता है) खोजने की आवश्यकता होती है। एक बार पहचाने जाने के बाद, यह पूरी तरह से अलग एकल पंक्ति या स्तंभ (result_vector) में समान स्थिति से संबंधित आउटपुट निकालता है। इसका सिंटैक्स है: =LOOKUP(lookup_value, lookup_vector, [result_vector])। इसके विपरीत, सरणी रूप (Array form) लक्ष्य मूल्य के लिए कोशिकाओं के एक परिभाषित ब्लॉक (सरणी) की पहली पंक्ति या स्तंभ को खोजता है। इसे खोजने पर, यह स्वचालित रूप से उस समान सरणी की अंतिम पंक्ति या स्तंभ में ठीक उसी स्थिति में स्थित संबंधित मूल्य को पुनः प्राप्त करता है। इसका सरलीकृत सिंटैक्स है: =LOOKUP(lookup_value, array)।
